newsitem.title: USA: Lehman names Feidelson to head equity finance.
newsitem.headline: Lehman names Feidelson to head equity finance.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said Monday it has named Robert Feidelson global head of its equity finance business.

Feidelson had been head of the Lehman Brothers European futures activities based in London. In his new position, he will be based in New York and report to Joseph Gregory, managing director and head of global equities.

Lehman also said Jeffrey Dorman, who spent 10 years at the firm before leaving in April to join Merrill Lynch and Co Inc, has rejoined Lehman as executive director of the equity finance business in London.

The Lehman equity finance group provides prime broker and clearing servcies to professional traders and broker-dealers, as well as securities borrowing and lending services to asset managers and custodians.
Lehman is a unit of Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc.
